d: Long, straight ash-brown hair with blunt-cut bangs and side-swept strands frames a youthful face with a gentle expression and narrow, dark brown eyes. A slender build is dressed in a black high-neck top, a brown plaid skirt, and a long white lab coat, paired with pink flat shoes and white stockings. Silver-rimmed glasses and a black identification lanyard are worn around the neck. The figure is seated in a metallic grey wheelchair with blue padding, connected to a tall IV stand holding a bag of yellow fluid.
